text.text: 9/20/2025, Last lunch in Taiwan. At Shilin station I accidentally came across an Italian noodle shop. I went and ordered a bacon noodle, hmmm the meat was rich in flavor and when I ate the noodles it reminded me of the days I was still in Europe so the taste was great. I hope when I return to Taiwan I can visit this place again.

text.text: We were there this weekend and the experience is so not good. The staffs don’t even smile when we entered the restaurant. Then she gave us a table beside the toilet even though she saw we have a baby with us and there are lots of empty tables on the other side of the room.  Many people came later and all of them were placed on the other side while we are the only persons on the toilet side (i feel discriminated).Then to prevent my baby from crying and disturbing other people, i gave her my phone to watch youTube, then the waitress went to the back and turned the music so loud that my baby can no longer hear what she’s watching that made baby irritable. And when she serve the food, she didn’t even smile or atleast nod when we said ‘thank you’ to her ( friendly huh?) The food is fair but we will never come back and will never recommend this to other people. This place is worse!!!
